description: This file defines the Extension model class within the Opencart Admin module, handling database interactions for extensions such as retrieving extension data, installing/uninstalling extensions, managing extension installs, and extension paths.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Model class for managing extension records in the database.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all extension names from the database.

methods.name: getExtensionsByType
methods.description: Retrieves extension records filtered by a specific type.

methods.name: getExtensionByCode
methods.description: Gets a specific extension record by its type and code.

methods.name: getTotalExtensionsByExtension
methods.description: Returns the total count of records for a specific extension type.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Inserts a new extension record into the database if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Deletes an extension record by its type and code, and removes related settings.

methods.name: addInstall
methods.description: Creates a new record for an extension installation, returning its ID.

methods.name: deleteInstall
methods.description: Removes an extension install record by its ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific extension install record.

methods.name: getInstall
methods.description: Fetches an extension install record by its ID.

methods.name: getInstallByExtensionDownloadId
methods.description: Retrieves an install record based on the extension download ID.

methods.name: getInstallByCode
methods.description: Fetches an install record by its code.

methods.name: getInstalls
methods.description: Retrieves a list of extension install records with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalInstalls
methods.description: Returns the total number of extension install records with optional filters.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a new file path record for an extension install.

methods.name: deletePath
methods.description: Deletes an extension path record by its ID.

methods.name: getPathsByExtensionInstallId
methods.description: Fetches all path records associated with an extension install.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Retrieves paths matching a specific pattern.

methods.name: getTotalPaths
methods.description: Counts how many extension path records match a pattern.
